event.eventName: Paytm Build for India Ai Hackathon - Delhi Edition
event.description:
Paytm Build for India AI Hackathon – Delhi Edition

The Paytm Build for India AI Hackathon – Delhi Edition brings together developers, students, founders, product thinkers, designers, and AI enthusiasts to build innovative solutions for real-world fintech challenges.

Organized by Paytm in collaboration with n8n, Sarvam, and Cognee, the hackathon gives participants an opportunity to explore AI, build impactful products, and solve meaningful challenges across the Paytm ecosystem.

WHY PARTICIPATE?

  • Solve real-world fintech challenges using AI.

  • Get access to AI credits and exclusive goodies to support your project.

  • Explore potential hiring opportunities with Paytm and showcase your skills to industry teams.

  • Compete for exciting prizes, rewards, and recognition.

  • Build and showcase your solution at the offline hackathon in Noida.

  • Connect with fellow developers, founders, designers, and AI enthusiasts.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

  1. Track 1: Merchant Growth AI
    Build the AI business partner for every Paytm merchant.

  2. Track 2: AI-Powered Financial Journeys
    Make Insurance, Lending and Fintech simpler, faster and more human.

  3. Track 3: Autonomous AI Teammates
    Build AI teammates that don't just respond; they get the job done

IMPORTANT — SHORTLISTING PROCESS

Only one round of PPT submission will be conducted. Teams will be shortlisted based on their PPT submission, and only shortlisted participants/teams will be invited to the offline final round in Noida.

Build with AI. Solve for India.

prizeBreakdown.perksAndGoodies: Top performing participants get interview opportunity with Paytm  (Sponsored by Paytm)
Best AI Usage Team / Participant gets $20,000 worth of AI credits across n8n, Cognee and Sarvam.

tracks.name: Merchant Growth AI
tracks.description:
Build the AI business partner for every Paytm merchant.

Build scalable AI-led solutions that help Paytm merchants grow their business, manage operations, and serve customers better. Think beyond payments, identify opportunities where AI can become a trusted business copilot for millions of merchants.

Example - How might we build an AI copilot that helps a Paytm merchant increase sales by understanding their business, identifying growth opportunities, and recommending or executing the right actions?

tracks.name: AI-Powered Financial Journeys
tracks.description:
Make Insurance, Lending and Fintech simpler, faster and more human.

Reimagine customer-facing journeys across Insurance, Lending and Fintech using AI. Focus on removing friction, reducing complexity, and helping customers complete critical financial journeys faster and with greater confidence.

Example - How might we simplify the Health Insurance claims journey using AI—from understanding policy coverage and submitting documents to tracking claims and resolving customer queries?

tracks.name: Autonomous AI Teammates
tracks.description:
Build AI teammates that don't just respond; they get the job done

Design an AI teammate that can go beyond answering questions and deliver measurable outcomes in sales or customer service. The AI should understand context, make decisions, take actions, and work alongside human teams.

Example - How might we build an AI teammate that can independently handle a customer-service or sales workflow end-to-end - resolving issues, taking actions across systems, and escalating to humans only when needed?

stages.name: PPT Submission
stages.description: Submit your solution presentation based on the problem statement you selected. Check the Tracks & Prizes section for the problem statements and prepare your PPT accordingly.
